title: In a memo to employees, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma lays out priorities for the unit, including returning to player and revenue growth by the end of fiscal year 2027 (The Verge)
summary: The Verge: In a memo to employees, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma lays out priorities for the unit, including returning to player and revenue growth by the end of fiscal year 2027 — Asha Sharma wants Xbox to return to growth. Asha Sharma wants Xbox to return to growth.
